name: RE1 silencing transcription factor

function.text: REST encodes RE1-silencing transcription factor. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity and DNA-binding transcription repressor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and host-mediated suppression of viral transcription.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to Wilms tumor 6 (autosomal dominant); fibromatosis, gingival, 5 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; strong GenCC assertion from Labcorp Genetics (formerly Invitae). Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
